title: Scott’s Tots
one_paragraph_synopsis: Michael Scott confronts the consequences of a long-ago promise to pay college tuition for a group of third graders, now high school seniors. As the students express gratitude and anticipation, Michael reveals he cannot fulfill the promise, leading to disappointment and conflict. Meanwhile, office dynamics unfold with Andy proposing an Employee of the Month program, Dwight scheming against Jim, and confusion arising over the award recipients. Michael attempts to make amends by offering alternative support, while tensions and uncertainties about the future remain.
